pretreatments.description: Ultrasonication with varying power levels and times (5, 10, 20, 40, and 60 minutes) at 20 kHz frequency.
Alkaline pretreatment using 6 mol/L KOH solution to achieve pH values of 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 for 1 hour.
Combined pretreatment where alkali-pretreated sludge at pH 9, 11, or 13 (1 hour) was subsequently ultrasonicated for 5, 20, or 60 minutes.
